name: Monte Carlo Radiance Estimate for Scene Reconstruction
definition: An unbiased color estimate for any given number of samples k, suitable for architectures that evaluate the density field faster than the radiance field, such as voxel-based models like DVGO.
summary: Monte Carlo Radiance Estimate is an unbiased color estimation method for differentiable volume rendering that accelerates training by replacing deterministic ray marching with stochastic sampling.
